title: Constructibility and base-change equality of the geometrically reduced fibre locus
statement:
Let $A\to B$ be a finitely presented homomorphism of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. For a prime $\mathfrak p$ of $A$ let $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ be its residue field [def-weil-residue-field], and put
$$E_{\mathrm{red}}(B/A)=\{\mathfrak p\in\operatorname{Spec}A\mid B\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak p)\text{ is geometrically reduced over }\kappa(\mathfrak p)\}.$$
Here geometrically reduced means that the spectrum is reduced after every field extension, as in [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible], and $\operatorname{Spec}$ is [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Then $E_{\mathrm{red}}(B/A)$ is constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset]. Moreover, for every homomorphism $a:A\to A'$ of commutative rings, with $B'=B\otimes_A A'$, one has
$$E_{\mathrm{red}}(B'/A')=(\operatorname{Spec}a)^{-1}(E_{\mathrm{red}}(B/A)).$$
No flatness, injectivity or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 0579 (lemma-geometrically-reduced-constructible) and 0576 (lemma-base-change-fibres-geometrically-reduced), affine ring form. In 0579 the locus is locally constructible; on the affine (hence qcqs) base it is constructible by Properties Tag 054C (lemma-locally-constructible).

mathlib_searches.query: For a finitely presented commutative algebra the set of primes where its fibre is geometrically reduced is constructible and this locus pulls back exactly under arbitrary base change
mathlib_searches.results: PrimeSpectrum.isConstructible_range_comap and isConstructible_comap_image, open-map Chevalley results, and Algebra.IsGeometricallyReduced definitions/criteria. These do not give the fibre locus.

mathlib_searches.query: The geometrically reduced fibre locus of a finitely presented algebra is constructible and commutes with base change
mathlib_searches.results: Algebra.IsGeometricallyReduced, isGeometricallyReduced_iff, of_forall_fg, and Scheme.Hom.isLocallyConstructible_image; no fibre-locus constructibility.
0 hits; Loogle reports unknown identifier IsConstructible.

Read Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Geometrically/Reduced.lean and Integral.lean: definitions, fibre criteria and base-change stability, but no constructible locus theorem. Grep restricted to AlgebraicGeometry.

mathlib_searches.query: For a finite presentation morphism of affine schemes the loci of geometrically reduced and geometrically irreducible fibres are locally constructible
mathlib_searches.results: Chevalley image/preimage constructibility, LocallyOfFinitePresentation and fibre Jacobson instances; none asserts constructibility of geometric fibre loci.
Only GroupTheory/Coset/Card.lean:67 (wikidata Q505798, an unrelated numeric substring). No geometric fibre-locus theorem.
